data.one_liner: A compiler to convert SVGs to the binary format used by package:vector_graphics.
data.what_it_does: Parses SVG files and compiles them into an optimized binary format for rendering via the vector_graphics runtime. It handles groups, paths, gradients, text, symbols, images, and patterns while applying several optimization techniques.
use_when: You need to precompile SVGs into binary format for vector_graphics.
You want optimized SVG rendering performance in your Flutter application.
avoid_when: You are parsing SVGs dynamically at runtime without precompilation.
strengths: Supports a wide range of SVG features including gradients, text, and patterns.
Performs optimizations like transformation inlining and group collapsing.
Protects against security issues like circular references and Billion Laughs exploits.
weaknesses: Does not support SVG filters or certain text processing attributes.
